title: Vapouriz 50/50 Blue Raspberry 10ml
description: Blue Raspberry delivers a vibrant, sweet-tart vape with the distinctive candy-like tang of raspberry flavour. The inhale is bold and juicy, while the exhale offers a slight sour edge, making for a punchy all-day vape with a nostalgic twist. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is well suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping styles and works best in pod kits, refillable pens and low-powered starter devices. Made in the UK by Vapouriz Labs, the Vapouriz 50/50 collection offers a variety of fruit, sweet and classic profiles crafted for balanced performance and consistent flavour delivery. It's an ideal choice for new vapers or those using lower-powered e-cigarette setups. Thanks to its 50/50 blend of VG and PG, this e-liquid delivers a smooth throat hit, discreet vapour and bold flavour—perfect for everyday use across a wide range of vape devices.
